channel.title: From Luam
channel.description: Plain-language articles on mental health, written or reviewed by licensed clinicians in Nairobi.

item.title: Psychiatrist or psychologist? Who to see first
item.description: The two roles overlap but they are not the same. A plain-language guide to who does what, and how to choose where to start.

item.title: Brain gardening: small daily habits that keep a mind healthy
item.description: A healthy mind is tended, not fixed. Think of your habits as watering, light and weeding, and see which small changes are worth starting this week.

item.title: Niksen: the Dutch art of doing nothing, and why your mind may need it
item.description: Niksen means doing something with no purpose. Here is what that looks like, why it can calm an overworked mind, and how to try it without guilt.
